_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Information Assurance (IA) Design Review Information Package (DRIP)
summary: The IA Design Review Information Package (DRIP) is used by the government to review the Defense in-Depth (DiD) design and support the Platform Risk Assessment (PRA) of the ship.
use_relationship:
The Information Assurance (IA) Design Review Information Package (DRIP) will be used by the government to review the Defense in-Depth (DiD) design and support the Platform Risk Assessment (PRA) of the ship.
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The IA DRIP shall be presented in format similar to that of Figures 1 through 7.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The IA DRIP workbook shall contain updatable tables for the each section.

children.title: Executive Summary, Section 1.
children.content: This section shall contain all of the information specified in figure 1 and shall also identify following:

children.title: System description and purpose.
Mission Assurance Category per DoDI 8500.2
Security Classification.
Security Mode of Operation.
Information Assurance Certification and Accreditation (IA C&A) Boundary, Section 2.
children.content: This section shall be presented in a format similar to that of Figure 2 and shall contain the following headings:

children.title: Schematic Interface Diagram placed above the headings showing:
Major Subsystems
Information Assurance defense points including:
Firewalls
Routers
Nomenclature name of each subsystem within IA C&A Boundary
Functional description of each subsystem within IA C&A Boundary
Description of User Roles and Privileges of each subsystem within IA C&A Boundary
Technical Cyber Defense Mitigation in each subsystem within IA C&A Boundary
Critical Protected Information (CPI) of each subsystem within IA C&A Boundary
System Requirements Verification Matrix (IA SRVM), Section 3.
children.content: This section shall be presented in a format similar to that of Figure 3 and shall also contain the following headings:

children.title: Applicable DoDI 8500.2 IA Controls
Software Requirement Specifications (SRS)
System Subsystem Specifications (SSS) to illustrate how the Defense in-Depth (DiD) design meets the IA Controls.
The IA MNC section shall be presented in a format similar to that of Figure 4 and shall also contain the following headings:
Date of data entry into the MNC
Description of function provided by or supported by connection
Reference Application Programming Interface (API) specification
LAN Technology
IP of the Data Source device transmitting data
Subnet Mask
Default Gateway
Hostname of the Data Source device transmitting data
Classification of the Data Source device transmitting the data
Classification of the actual data being transmitted
Network Data Transfer Protocol used to transmit the data
Data Delivery Type: Bi-Directional, Uni-Directional or Multicast
IANA Port Number assigned to transmit the data
Service daemon transmitting the data
Is Port, Protocol and Service approved by DISA (Yes or No)
Data encryption standard used
Is Data Source device inside the IA C&A Boundary (Yes or No)
IP of the Data Sink/Destination device receiving transmitted data
Hostname of the Data Sink/Destination device receiving data
Classification of the Data Sink/Destination device receiving data
Is Data Sink/Destination device within IA C&A Boundary (Yes or No)
The Information Assurance-Master Network Connection (IA MNC), Section 4.
children.content: This section shall contain the basis for building Access Control Lists (ACLs) in accordance with the following DODI 8500.2 IA Controls:

children.title: DCPP-1 Ports, Protocols, and Services
DCFA-1 Functional Architecture for AIS Applications,
DCFA-1 Functional Architecture for AIS Applications,
DCID-1 Interconnection Documentation and
ECIC-1 Interconnections Among DoD Systems and Enclaves.
The IA-MNC section shall identify changes when made to the network connections in system upgrades or Engineering Change Proposals (ECPs).

The IA-MNC section shall identify all network connections that route to, from, through and across the networked subsystems within the Information Assurance Certification and Accreditation (IA C&A) boundary.
The IA-MNC section shall specify the network connections for capabilities and functions performed within the Information Assurance boundary "the enclave".
Common Assurance System Architecture (CASA) Section 5.
children.content: This section shall be presented in format similar to that of Figure 5 and shall contain the following headings:

children.title: Incident Alert Categories
Incident Alert Conditions
Threat Model for IA C&A Boundary, Section 6.
children.content: This section shall be in presented in format similar to that of Figure 6 and shall contain:

children.title: Internal and External IA Threat Exploits
Technical and Logical Mitigations
Mitigation by Design, Inheritance or Procedure
Applicable STIGS for IA C&A Boundary, Section 7.
children.content: This section shall be in presented in format similar to that of Figure 7 and shall contain:

children.title: Applicable STIG
Rationale

preparation_instructions.title: Media Requirement.
preparation_instructions.content: The electronic media for the IA DRIP package shall be Microsoft Excel, Version 2003-2007.
